description: `<Suspense fallback={...}>` shows its fallback while any component inside it is suspended, and reveals the content together when ready.
TanStack Query hook that suspends until data is available. `data` is always defined; errors are thrown to error boundaries.
React 19 API that suspends on a promise. The promise must be cached across renders, not created during render.
Nested boundaries let important content appear first while secondary parts keep loading.
Start requests before rendering (loaders, prefetching, event handlers) so components suspend on data that is already on its way.
